_about: Public-domain John Hey (1734-1815), first Norrisian Professor of Divinity at Cambridge, for the Word Hoard: his Lectures in Divinity delivered in the University of Cambridge (Cambridge: John Burges, 1796-1798, four volumes), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 42 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
